content: Efesus Sios Bun Od Ilef
“Efesus sios nẽ engel bun utot: Od enei are, ĩ barisa sewen ima biyalẽ irou mog, sewen gol lam tutur difaren atun iyok ilen nẽ od:

Ereb õ ago wof, are aya keleĩ, ogon kabĩ totol yaleya ado ogon feseya sã ifareya anĩ. Aya keleĩ, õ tamo sesen to loloum weid fen, idi dogo anĩ aposel dedig, anĩ ere, aposel sã anidi es wiyeĩd fen, idi neid idegẽya anĩ ulen.
Õ totol ufar fen, neu yanau nigin morõ faali won, anĩ ere, õ to fõ yon.
Anĩ ere, aya õ nigin od enei ado: Õ uruwa aya nigin waũ laa fen anĩ utoron.
Anĩ nigin, õ nainenem kubũ won anĩ kisi wo! Falei wo fen, ereb uruwa agon anĩ agouf. Õ to falei wouf are, aya õ gein asi fen, ogon lam tutur ado yogon modoũ bun tamal alelauf.
Anĩ ere, tobonunã biya enei õ ado: Õ Nikolas dõ difiyek neid tobonuneid to oroyõdig, are ayag to oroudig.
Taka ĩ weder adouf, utornẽg len, ĩ Awa Uur sios irokenẽdif anĩ karĩ youf. Aib ĩ kusĩ anĩ wal fouf, aya ĩ mata ifenẽya nẽ aa Negur nẽ paradis bun ibodok anĩ bun tamal, yõya nigin yo afiyẽf.
Smerna Sios Bun Od Ilef
“Smerna sios nẽ engel bun utot: Od enei are, ĩ gariya ado idikeleya, ĩ laaf fen, baban mata fã yen nẽ od.
Ogon darau ado ogon maleg nigin aya keleĩ, anĩ ere, õ safina musei ado. Aya idi dogo nigin Juda tamo dedig, anĩ ere, idi Juda tamo sã, Satan nẽ guru fiya anidi neid bou yũya od nigin keleĩ.

Ereb mogo õ darau ifonõf nigin to kumĩ wo. Aya õ arokonok, Satan ĩ mogo ã tunĩ kisi yeĩya nigin kalabus bun ineneĩf. Age fe di, ã naa ten darau walogouf. Õ laa bun dinenõfeg, ogon momoiya urou kafĩ walauf, ago di, aya õ mata nẽ teter kurũ ayõf.
Taka ĩ weder adouf, utornẽg len, ĩ Awa Uur sios irokenẽdif anĩ karĩ youf. Aib ĩ kusĩ anĩ wal fouf, namba tu nẽ laa ĩ to daũ fiyẽf.
Pergamum Sios Bun Od Ilef
“Pergamum sios nẽ engel bun utot: Od enei are, ĩ dimig bala waila si sitakã ado nẽ od.

Õ ubodok nẽ an aya keleĩ, an Satan nẽ sia ibodok. Anĩ ere, õ neu yanau urou kafĩ welef. Antipas, neu dõ fiya biya, aya nigin od wogõ yedig, ĩ Satan ibodok nẽ ãgenei taun an dukesin sain anĩ buneg, õ aya nigin ogon momoiya to folõ welen.

Anĩ ere, aya õ nigin od tunĩ ado: Õ tamo tunĩ an Balam nẽ keleĩ dirouf anidi ado, Balam ĩ Balak ifelnẽ di, Balak ĩ Israel tamo kayau yeid tũ fiya nẽ meein ino fen, idegnẽdi di, Israel idi saaf idegẽya waitou bun sesewi difen anĩ dokon, noli tobonunã dinon.
Age fiya gen, õ aneg tunĩ Nikolas nẽ ifelnẽya dirouf anidi ado.
Anĩ nigin, waũ falei wo! Sãf are, aya kaisã bagai õ gein asi fen, neu sigorou nẽ dimig ado idi geid kusĩ auf.

Taka ĩ weder adouf, utornẽg len, ĩ Awa Uur sios irokenẽdif anĩ karĩ youf. Aib ĩ kusĩ anĩ wal fouf, aya ĩ mana iminẽyan ibodok tunĩ afenẽf. Aya ĩ meein lalau takag, yana mata teten itoton anĩ afenẽf. Aib ĩ anĩ yalef dogol yana anĩ keleĩ youf.
Taiataira Sios Bun Od Ilef
“Taiataira sios nẽ engel bun utot: Od enei are Negur Naal nẽ od, yogon mala are yã mala fitotoleya gen, yogon ye are bras yã malan ifalegeya medeĩya gen.
Aya keleĩ, õ ereb agof, ogon waũ laa fiya ado momoiya, ogon aruna yaleya ado feseya sã ifareya. Aya keleĩ, õ uruwa bun ago won anĩ wal fiya gama õ agodig.

Anĩ ere, aya õ nigin od enei ado: Õ kayau Jesebel, ĩ yogo nigin profet kayau yef anĩ, loloum wedig. Ĩ yogon ifelnẽya bunem neu ferfer idegnẽdi di, idi noli tobonunã bun dile fen, saaf idegẽya waitou sesewi difen anĩ dõdig.
Aya ĩ yogon mosor nigin wau falei youf nigin sain afenen, anĩ ere, ĩ to orof.
Anĩ nigin, aya ĩ darau nẽ fatar bun ara ken, idi ĩ geid seseirã dinodig anidi, kayau anĩ nẽ naab nigin waud to falei youf are, aya idi darau fatuk bagai afenẽdiyouf.
Aya ĩ gere tar adenkesiyouf. Age afe di, sios ganan, aya waud ado kisi es afedig anĩ keleĩ youf. Age afe fen, aya ã mugu mugu ereb ereb ã ago gef kilei, mala solo afeneĩf.
Anĩ ere, aya ã tunĩ ganan Taiataira ufaregef anĩ arokeneik, ã kayau anĩ nẽ ifelnẽya to uroug fen, Satan nẽ waa namen bagai dedig anĩ to kelein anĩ arokeneik (aya ã bun ereb morõ taka to afeneĩf).
Ereb ã urougef anĩ dogol urougef uleg mog, asiyouf.
Aib ĩ kusĩ anĩ wal fe fen, neu oroya dõf ile, idikeleya bun ouf, aya ĩ teneub lo fediya nigin megeir afenẽf.

content.text: ĩ mis gen daũ fedi di, urud falaisiyouf,’

content: are aya neu Dei bunem megeir alen gen.
Aya ĩ bonimei nẽ barisa kilokilog afenẽf.
Taka ĩ weder adouf, utornẽg len, ĩ Awa Uur sios irokenẽdif anĩ karĩ youf.
